summaryForNext: Scoped assess for proposed change uar-ui-knowme-convergence: UAR frontend (React 19, Tailwind 3.4, assistant-ui) already shares KnowMe's ember Flat 2.0 DNA but differs in tokens (surface ladder, radius, fonts, theme mechanism), shell/nav pattern, message-part contract (ContentBlock union), and one blocking conflict — TanStack Query 5 vs preserve-entity-management.
